annotations.title: The account review and its facts

description: The deep read of each ad account, as a senior campaigner sees it: the written review (verdict, tracking, top findings with the fix and its monthly worth) and the facts under it. Per search campaign: impression share, share lost to budget and to rank, top-of-page share, bid strategy and Google's status of it, and what holds it back (demand, budget or rank). Search terms over 30 days split brand vs non-brand (spend, conversions, value), the top converting and the top wasted searches; the most expensive keywords with quality score; conversion actions (which are primary, how they count); devices; landing pages; where Performance Max money goes; tracking switches. Useful for 'why', 'can we spend more?', 'what holds us back?', 'is tracking right?', 'which searches waste money?'. Google accounts have the most here.
